title: Maximum Count of Positive Integer and Negative Integer
summary: For an array nums arranged in ascending order, determine the higher count between the positive and negative integers.
statement: For an array nums arranged in ascending order, determine the higher count between the positive and negative integers. Specifically, if there are pos positive integers and neg negative integers, return the greater of pos and neg. Note that zero is considered neither positive nor negative.
constraints: nums is sorted in nondecreasing order.
Zero is neither positive nor negative.
Return the larger of the positive-element count and negative-element count.
hints: In a sorted array, negatives form a prefix and positives form a suffix.
len(nums)-bisect_right(nums,0) gives the positive count; return the larger.
The two binary-search boundaries exclude the entire contiguous zero block exactly.
editorial: The two binary-search boundaries exclude the entire contiguous zero block exactly.

tests.explanation: There are three negative and three positive values, so the maximum count is three.
Three negatives exceed two positives, so the result is three.
